page_title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems

summary.name: MemGPT
summary.one_liner: An arXiv research paper introducing MemGPT, an OS-inspired system that manages LLM memory tiers to give language models extended context beyond their limited context windows.
use_cases: analyzing documents larger than an LLM's context window
building chat agents that remember users across sessions
studying OS-inspired memory management for LLMs
reading background on LLM agent memory design
summary.what_it_does: The paper proposes virtual context management, a technique borrowing from hierarchical memory in operating systems that moves data between fast and slow memory to give an LLM the appearance of a much larger context. It introduces MemGPT, a system that manages these memory tiers to keep extended context within the model's window. MemGPT uses interrupts to manage control flow between itself and the user. The authors evaluate it on document analysis, where it handles documents far exceeding the context window, and on multi-session chat, where it creates agents that remember and evolve over long interactions. The page states the code and experiment data are released at memgpt.ai.
